/mnt/8t/xubuqiang/anaconda3/lib/python3.12/site-packages/numpy/__init__.py:95: -----------------------------
/mnt/8t/xubuqiang/anaconda3/lib/python3.12/site-packages/numpy/__init__.py:96: Most of the functions in `numpy` return a copy of the array argument
/mnt/8t/xubuqiang/anaconda3/lib/python3.12/site-packages/numpy/__init__.py:97: (e.g., `np.sort`).  In-place versions of these functions are often
/mnt/8t/xubuqiang/anaconda3/lib/python3.12/site-packages/numpy/__init__.py:98: available as array methods, i.e. ``x = np.array([1,2,3]); x.sort()``.
